Card Q&A.q: If I have 1 card with [Armor Form] in its traits in my trash, can I use this card's effect to give an opponent's Digimon -4000 DP, and then give it an additional -1000 DP with the second part of the effect?

Effect: While you have a Digimon with [Armor Form] in its traits in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.
[Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn, and all of your opponent's Digimon get -1000 DP for the turn for each card with [Armor Form] in its traits in your trash.
